summary: Tested UX overhaul features (14 items across 6 phases). All features PASS: DeliveryBar with auto-location + pincode entry, discount badges (15% drugs, 10% OTC, 10% lab tests), sticky cart bar (Blinkit-style), empty cart recommendations, cart price summary with flat discount + auto-coupon, FAB repurpose (Consult/Scan Rx/Quick Order), category icons (images not emojis), WhatsApp button cleanup on Nutricare.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 UX overhaul features verified working. DeliveryBar at top of Pharmacy/Nutricare pages with pincode sheet (auto-detect + manual input). Medicine cards show green discount badges (15% for tablets/capsules/syrups, 10% for OTC). Sticky cart bar (FloatingCartButton) appears above bottom nav when cart has items - shows item count + total + View Cart. Empty cart page shows 'Recommended For You' trending products. Cart price summary shows: MRP total → Flat Discount (15%/10%) → Auto Coupon (if ≥₹2000) → Delivery → Final Total. BottomNav FAB shows Consult, Scan Rx, Quick Order options. Mango page has 10% OFF banner in light zone. Category icons use proper images (not emojis). WhatsApp floating button removed from Nutricare.

14_price_summary.details: Cart price summary shows: MRP total → Flat Discount (15%/10%) → Standard Delivery → Total. Auto-coupon shows when applicable (≥₹2000). Upsell message shown.
